name: strimz
description: Strimz — B2B subscription billing infrastructure for stablecoin commerce on Arc.

pnpm._overridesNote: @reown/appkit-adapter-wagmi@1.8.x declares `@wagmi/connectors: >=5.9.9` as an open-ended optionalDependency. With no upper bound, pnpm picks @wagmi/connectors@8.x (the wagmi 3.x companion line) which ships a broken peer pin: it pins @wagmi/core@3.4.9 exact, but its `exports/index.js` re-exports `tempoWallet from '@wagmi/core/tempo'` — a path @wagmi/core@3.4.9 doesn't export. Result: cold install fails with `Module not found: ./tempo`. We cap connectors to ^5.x — the line matching wagmi 2.x that the Reown adapter was built against — so the @wagmi/* tree resolves consistently.
pnpm._typesReactNote: Some transitive deps pull @types/react@19.2.x while apps/web pins ^19.0.0. Two copies of @types/react in node_modules produce two distinct `ReactNode` types, so passing children between packages typechecks as incompatible. Pin one version everywhere.
pnpm._onlyBuiltDependenciesNote: Lefthook ships a Go binary that pnpm post-install fetches into node_modules — that's a build script, and pnpm@10 blocks them by default for safety. We explicitly opt this in so `pnpm install` wires the git hooks via the root `prepare` script.
